+    seconds = round(seconds, conf.round)
+    if seconds < 60.:
+        return '{}{:{}f}s'.format(conf.prefix, seconds, conf.sec_prec)
+

+    if minutes < 60.:
+        if conf.round_sec_on_min:

+        # Format seconds as two digits when less than 10 for proper time display

+            int(conf.min_prec), int((conf.min_prec % 1) * 10))
+        return '{}{:.0f}{}'.format(conf.prefix, minutes, sec_format).format(seconds)
+

+    if conf.clear_sec_on_hour:
+        seconds = 0
+    # Format seconds as two digits when less than 10 for proper time display

+        int(conf.hour_prec), int((conf.hour_prec % 1) * 10))

+def time_display(seconds: float, conf: TimeDisplay) -> str:
+    seconds = round(seconds, conf.round)
+    if seconds < 60.:

+    if minutes < 60.:

+    if conf.clear_sec_on_hour:

+    # Format seconds as two digits when less than 10 for proper time display
+    sec_format = ':02.0f' if conf.hour_prec == 2.0 else ':0{}.{}f'.format(
